events.title: Francis Xavier dies within sight of China
events.description: The Jesuit missionary Francis Xavier died of fever on Shangchuan Island while waiting to enter mainland China. He had preached in India, South-East Asia and Japan, and was canonised in 1622.
events.html: The Jesuit missionary Francis Xavier died of fever on Shangchuan Island while waiting to enter mainland China. He had preached in India, South-East Asia and Japan, and was canonised in 1622.

events.title: Moreau defeats the Austrians at Hohenlinden
events.description: French forces under General Jean Moreau crushed an Austrian army in snowy forest east of Munich. The defeat forced Austria to make peace at Lunéville in February 1801.

events.title: Georges Claude shows neon lighting at the Paris Motor Show
events.description: At the Paris Motor Show, the French engineer Georges Claude displayed glowing tubes of neon gas. Neon signs soon became a fixture of advertising and city nightlife worldwide.

events.title: Christiaan Barnard performs the first human heart transplant
events.description: At Groote Schuur Hospital in Cape Town, Christiaan Barnard's team transplanted a heart into Louis Washkansky. He lived for 18 days before dying of pneumonia, but the operation launched transplant surgery.

events.title: Toxic gas leaks from a pesticide plant in Bhopal
events.description: Methyl isocyanate escaped from a Union Carbide plant in Bhopal overnight, killing thousands within days. Total deaths are estimated in the range of 15,000 or more, and hundreds of thousands suffered lasting harm.
